# src/audio Documentation

*This file is automatically generated by merging README files from multiple branches.*

## From branch: codex/add-audio-readme-files-and-review-integration-2025-06-22


This directory contains the runtime implementation for audio capture and pattern
analysis.  `pipewire_capture.cpp` wraps PipeWire so the engine can ingest live
microphone data.  `pipeline.cpp` then converts those samples into pattern vectors
for the core engine.

## PipeWire Capture
The `PipeWireCapture` class establishes a PipeWire context and manages a
`pw_stream` that feeds raw float samples to the engine.  When PipeWire headers
are unavailable the build falls back to stub types via
`pipewire_includes.h`, allowing the rest of the module to compile without the
PipeWire library.

## Audio Pipeline
`AudioPipeline` collects frames of audio, applies a Hann window, performs a
simplified FFT and extracts spectral features such as fundamental frequency and
spectral centroid.  Those features are normalised into `glm::vec3` pattern
vectors that can be queued for further processing.

The pipeline is configured through `AudioPipelineConfig` (defined in
`include/audio/config.h`) which sets sample rate, PipeWire thread priority and
thresholds used by the coherence engine.

## Integration Notes
The audio code currently builds as a standalone component.  Keeping it separate
avoids pulling PipeWire and extra DSP dependencies into builds that only require
pattern analysis.  Once the pipeline stabilises it could be moved into
`src/core` so that pattern, context and audio evolution share a common lifecycle.

## Redundant Files
Before integrating with other modules ensure build artefacts such as
`cmake_install.cmake` files are removed.  One such file existed under
`src/quantum/` and has been deleted.

## From branch: codex/add-src/audio/readme.md-2025-06-22


This directory contains the real-time audio ingestion path. The current implementation relies on PipeWire for capture and converts frames into pattern vectors.

## PipeWire Capture Pipeline

`pipewire_capture.cpp` implements `AudioCapture` using PipeWire. Audio samples are pulled from the default source and forwarded to `AudioPipeline` for windowing and FFT analysis. Metrics such as peak and RMS levels are tracked in `AudioMetrics`.

`pipeline.cpp` performs the processing steps:

1. Collect frames into a ring buffer.
2. Apply a Hann window and perform an FFT.
3. Derive spectral features (fundamental frequency, spectral centroid, flux).
4. Emit normalized pattern vectors for the pattern processor.

## Future Ingestion Consolidation

Audio is the first capture backend. Additional modules (video or sensor streams) will likely share queueing and metric structures. A common ingestion interface is planned so audio, video and other sources can feed the same pattern analysis path. When these components land they will be staged under `src/ingest` and routed through a unified scheduler.

## Header Map

Public headers live in `include/audio`:

- **capture.h** – Abstract `AudioCapture` interface and factory.
- **pipewire_capture.h** – Concrete PipeWire implementation.
- **pipeline.h** – CPU side analysis pipeline.
- **config.h** – Configuration structures for pipeline and coherence logic.
- **types.h** – Common enums and metric structs.
- **pipewire_includes.h** – Conditional PipeWire wrappers for portability.

These headers are exported via the `sep_audio` library so other modules can create capture instances or process raw frames.

## From branch: codex/write-readme.md-for-pipewire-pipeline-components-2025-06-22


This directory implements the optional PipeWire based audio pipeline.  The code can be
compiled independently from the rest of the engine and provides real time capture as
well as basic spectral analysis.  The module is small and should be retained as a
separate library so Linux builds can exclude it when PipeWire headers are not
present.

## Components

- **pipeline.cpp** – Implements `AudioPipeline` which queues audio frames,
  performs a Hann window, runs a simplified FFT and converts the results into
  pattern vectors.
- **pipewire_capture.cpp** – Provides the `PipeWireCapture` class implementing
  `AudioCapture`.  It wraps the PipeWire API and feeds raw samples into the
  pipeline via callbacks.
- **config.cpp** – Defines `AudioPipelineConfig` and `AudioCoherenceEngine` for
  tuning the quantum coherence thresholds and memory tier rules.  A global
  `g_audio_config` instance is created here.
- **CMakeLists.txt** – Builds the sources into the `sep_audio` static library
  which other modules can link against.

These pieces form a thin layer that converts microphone input into pattern data
for the rest of the SEP engine.  Keeping them isolated simplifies packaging on
systems without PipeWire while still allowing full functionality when the
library is available.
